title: Lightweight Deep Learning-Based Channel Estimation for RIS-Aided Extremely Large-Scale MIMO Systems on Resource-Limited Edge Devices
abstract: arXiv:2507.09627v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Next-generation wireless technologies such as 6G aim to meet demanding requirements such as ultra-high data rates, low latency, and enhanced connectivity. Extremely Large-Scale MIMO (XL-MIMO) and Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface (RIS) are key enablers, with XL-MIMO boosting spectral and energy efficiency through numerous antennas, and RIS offering dynamic control over the wireless environment via passive reflective elements. However, realizing their full potential depends on accurate Channel State Information (CSI). Recent advances in deep learning have facilitated efficient cascaded channel estimation. However, the scalability and practical deployment of existing estimation models in XL-MIMO systems remain limited. translated_title: 面向资源受限边缘设备的轻量级深度学习RIS辅助超大规模MIMO信道估计
translated_abstract: 下一代无线技术如6G旨在满足超高数据速率、低延迟和增强连接等严苛要求。超大规模MIMO（XL-MIMO）和可重构智能表面（RIS）是关键使能技术，其中XL-MIMO通过大量天线提升频谱和能量效率，而RIS通过无源反射元件对无线环境进行动态控制。然而，实现其全部潜力依赖于精确的信道状态信息（CSI）。近期深度学习的进展促进了高效的级联信道估计。然而，现有估计模型在XL-MIMO系统中的可扩展性和实际部署仍受限。天线和RIS元件数量的增加对实时高效的信道估计构成了重大障碍，急剧增加了数据量，提升了计算复杂度，需要适应性的解决方案。
tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级深度学习方案，用于RIS辅助超大规模MIMO系统的信道估计，旨在解决资源受限边缘设备上的可扩展性和实时性挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight deep learning-based channel estimation approach for RIS-aided extremely large-scale MIMO systems, addressing scalability and real-time challenges on resource-limited edge devices.
